defaults.plannedExit: first liquid mark after catalyst or thesis invalidation; otherwise close before expiry week

entries.catalyst: post-IPO option liquidity and first public-market digestion
entries.mechanism: Cerebras is a direct frontier-compute scarcity asset, but post-IPO AGI scarcity premium can also unwind if valuation/customer/software concerns dominate.
entries.falsifier: chain remains too wide, customer concentration dominates, or disclosures fail to support durable frontier-compute demand

entries.catalyst: AI datacenter power-contract headlines, earnings, or guidance update
entries.mechanism: AI scaling shifts bottleneck attention from accelerators to dispatchable power and on-site generation.
entries.falsifier: new disclosures show power demand is already priced or project economics/capacity are weaker than expected

entries.catalyst: HBM/DRAM pricing, earnings, or AI memory supply commentary
entries.mechanism: AI scaling can move the binding constraint into memory bandwidth/capacity faster than consensus cycle models update.
entries.falsifier: pricing, utilization, or guide commentary shows memory scarcity is already fully priced

entries.catalyst: NAND/storage pricing update, earnings, or AI infrastructure storage demand commentary
entries.mechanism: Frontier training and inference scale can reprice storage/NAND scarcity beyond normal cycle framing.
entries.falsifier: pricing or demand commentary fails to support AI-driven storage scarcity

entries.catalyst: capacity, customer, financing, lockup, or utilization update
entries.mechanism: Neocloud capacity is a scarce AI-scaling asset, but financing and customer concentration make the equity fragile.
entries.falsifier: no evidence of capacity scarcity, financing stress dominates, or option IV absorbs the entire distribution

entries.catalyst: datacenter conversion contract, customer demand, power-site update, or financing event
entries.mechanism: Bitcoin-miner power footprints can be repriced as AI datacenter conversion assets.
entries.falsifier: conversion economics or financing fail to validate AI compute reuse

entries.catalyst: semi crowding, capex disappointment, rates shock, or export-control/policy shock
entries.mechanism: The obvious AI beta layer can break on crowding even while the deeper AI-scaling thesis remains intact.
entries.falsifier: breadth and earnings revisions continue to validate crowded semi beta without policy/rates pressure
